json_schema.title: Schema
json_schema.description: A complete schema suitable for generators in any language.

format_version.description: Interchange format version (independent of Telegram's layer).

layer.description: Telegram API layer advertised by the source.

value.description: Ordinary value or repeated field group.

ArgumentValue.description: The mutually exclusive forms of a combinator argument.

oneOf.description: One value with a TL type expression.

expression.description: Parsed expression; never a schema-name placeholder.

oneOf.description: A bracketed group repeated according to a natural expression.

multiplicity.description: Count expression, or the preceding natural argument when omitted.

id.description: Resolved constructor number (explicit or canonical CRC32).

id_explicit.description: Whether the source supplied the number instead of relying on canonical CRC32.

id_hex.description: Hex form convenient for languages with awkward unsigned integers.

layer.description:
Layer known for this declaration. Current flat schemas only identify the
containing layer and cannot prove an earlier introduction layer.

official_url.description: Official Telegram documentation page inferred from the declaration kind.

oneOf.description: Natural addition supported by the TL formal grammar.

introduced.description: First layer, only when the input explicitly provides it.

arguments.description: Set of random bytes to prevent content recognition in short encrypted messages. Clients are required to check that there are at least 15 random bytes included in each message. Messages with less than 15 random bytes must be ignored. Parameter moved here from decryptedMessage in Layer 17.
